schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "comments" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "issue_id" UUID,
  "comment_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "body" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "author" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "url" TEXT DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "development_request_histories" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "request_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "from_status" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "to_status" TEXT DEFAULT 'submitted',
  "actor_type" TEXT DEFAULT 'system',
  "actor_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "note" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "development_requests" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "project_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "integration_id" UUID,
  "requester_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "participant_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "type" TEXT DEFAULT 'feature',
  "description" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "evidence" TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
  "visibility" TEXT DEFAULT 'requester',
  "origin" TEXT DEFAULT 'managed-app',
  "discussion" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "status" TEXT DEFAULT 'submitted'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "issues" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "repository_id" UUID,
  "project_id" UUID,
  "number" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "node_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "title" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "body" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "state" TEXT DEFAULT 'open',
  "author" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "labels" JSON DEFAULT '[]',
  "assignees" JSON DEFAULT '[]',
  "comments_count" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "last_synced_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "original_body" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "synthesis_count" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "head_ref" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "base_ref" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "merged" BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  "merged_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "mergeable" BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  "draft" BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  "additions" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "deletions" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "changed_files" INTEGER DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_decisions" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "meta_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "role" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "tenant_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "question" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "decision_options" TEXT,
  "outcome" TEXT,
  "rationale" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
  "owner_type" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "owner_id" TEXT,
  "visibility" TEXT DEFAULT 'internal',
  "context_references" TEXT,
  "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "decided_at" TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_governance_events" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "meta_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "role" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "tenant_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "record_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'question',
  "action" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created',
  "actor_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system',
  "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "from_status" TEXT,
  "to_status" TEXT NOT NULL,

  "rationale" TEXT,
  "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "from_owner_type" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "from_owner_id" TEXT,
  "to_owner_type" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "to_owner_id" TEXT

help.markdown:
## Overview

Projects tracks the work you are planning: projects, the issues in them, and
the labels and comments that organise them.

## Tasks

### Start a project

1. Create a new project.
2. Give it a **{field:title}** and a **{field:description}**.

### Log an issue

1. Create a new issue and pick the **{field:projectId}**.
2. Write a **{field:title}** and a **{field:body}**.
3. Close it by setting **{field:state}** to closed. Comments are attached to the
   issue.
